summary: Arcturus S6 is a self-playing wavetable instrument for generative drones and soundscapes, in the style of early digital synths. No sequencer and no filter: movement comes from patched modulators.
features: Four PPG-style wavetable oscillators; 13 wavetables, one generative
Six Serge-style function generators, two sample-and-holds, a quadrature LFO
Four logic gate generators, free or on MIDI clock
Mod and gate matrices with feedback; 21 tunings with quantisers
Plate reverb with freeze, shift-register delay, flanger
16 named patches; random drone at power-on; tested on one FM-1
